answer: A concrete rule the ledger can enforce: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because dawn only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, wander is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any ridge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
